recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore ordinalValue/itemWeight extension contexts in core; any future desire to attach weights directly to ValueSet.compose.include.concept should be handled as a new Vocabulary/FHIR-I decision rather than as incomplete FHIR-33540 application.
issue_request: FHIR-33540 asked for ordinalValue/itemWeight weights from coded concepts to be propagated into value set expansion concepts. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution required removing CodeSystem.concept, ValueSet.compose.include.concept, and ValueSet.expansion.contains contexts from the itemWeight extension; using http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#itemWeight for CodeSystem and ValueSet; adding itemWeight as a decimal concept property; and updating the defined-properties table.
initial_application: Core commit 3d7a100629ff78f7ad6b25489616e332ce2d6a5e added itemWeight to source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml. Same-day adjacent core commit f43f55953f3d55407718d24c676f2471597f9deb added the itemWeight row to source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml. Extension Pack commit 784a10b5c83c80ad7f387b244b4eee65558ec624 removed the CodeSystem and ValueSet contexts from StructureDefinition-itemWeight and added the property guidance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes CodeSystem, ValueSet, and the concept-properties CodeSystem. Later FHIR-48428 work added explicit dataType metadata, leaving itemWeight as decimal. ValueSet.$expand has a property input parameter, and ValueSet.expansion.contains.property carries returned property values. A 2026 Zulip discussion raised ValueSet.compose.include.concept weights but confirmed the current property-based interpretation and did not identify a later WG decision reversing FHIR-33540.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already contains itemWeight with dataType decimal, the defined-properties table includes itemWeight, expansion concepts support property values, and the Extension Pack itemWeight definition no longer allows the removed CodeSystem/ValueSet contexts while directing those resources to the itemWeight property.

Created the older general ordinalValue extension contexts that FHIR-33540 later narrowed for CodeSystem and ValueSet use.
Later applied work added explicit dataType values to the Concept Properties CodeSystem, including itemWeight as decimal.
